description: This header file declares functions, structures, and includes needed for command utilities within the Cuttlefish host project, mainly dealing with reading exit codes, managing monitor sockets, and launcher actions.
external_methods: Result<SharedFD> GetLauncherMonitorFromInstance(const CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific& instance_config, const int timeout_seconds)
Result<SharedFD> GetLauncherMonitor(const CuttlefishConfig& config, int instance_num, int timeout_seconds)
Result<void> RunLauncherAction(SharedFD monitor_socket, LauncherAction action, std::optional<int> timeout_seconds)
Result<void> RunLauncherAction(SharedFD monitor_socket, const run_cvd::ExtendedLauncherAction& extended_action, std::optional<int> timeout_seconds)

classes.name: LauncherActionInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a launcher action, including the type of action and extended action details.

methods.name: ReadExitCode
methods.description: Reads the exit code from the monitor socket and returns it wrapped in a Result.

methods.name: GetLauncherMonitorFromInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the launcher monitor socket for a specific instance config within a given timeout.

methods.name: GetLauncherMonitor
methods.description: Obtains the launcher monitor socket for a specified configuration and instance number.

methods.name: ReadLauncherActionFromFd
methods.description: Reads and parses launcher action information from the monitor socket.

methods.name: WaitForRead
methods.description: Waits for data to be available to read on the monitor socket within a timeout.

methods.name: RunLauncherAction
methods.description: Sends a launcher action request through the socket and awaits the response, checking for errors.

methods.name: RunLauncherAction
methods.description: Overloaded function to send an extended launcher action request and await confirmation.
